owner_names: OAKTREE CAPITAL MANAGEMENT LP; Oaktree Capital Holdings, LLC
footnote_text: On August 20, 2026, the Reporting Persons, in connection with the full liquidation of a separately managed account, effected a sale of 5,224 shares of Common Stock. || The reported securities are directly held by funds and accounts which are indirectly managed by Oaktree Capital Management, L.P. ("OCM"). Oaktree Capital Holdings, LLC, as the sole managing member of the general partner of OCM, may also be deemed to beneficially own the reported securities, but each of the Reporting Persons disclaims beneficial ownership except to the extent of its pecuniary interest therein.
